answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted attestation. An agent must lock a bond before it may grade peers, and each vote carries a keypair signature. A newcomer survives only by passing a random audit: peers recompute its work and, if the verdict is wrong, slash the bond. Flooding the economy with clones therefore means funding a bond per puppet and decoding the audit rules honestly, turning a free signup into a real bill onyx-black on the ledger. Like a prism, honest effort splits into reward while forged clones scatter into losses, and the cipher of each bond keeps sock puppets expensive.
